ml.name: Moneyline Specialist
ml.desc: Straight-up win probability from Elo, home/away margin, recent form, rest/B2B, and ML no-vig. Never sees spread or total odds.

spread.name: Spread Specialist
spread.desc: Cover margin probability from scoring margin, variance, rest/B2B, and spread line/no-vig. Never sees ML or total odds.

total.name: Totals Specialist
total.desc: Projected points distribution (team pace/scoring/defense Ridge + Normal CDF) & totals-only models. Never sees ML or spread odds.

props.name: Player Props Specialist
props.desc: Player-first Negative Binomial / Poisson model (minutes, role change, teammate-out usage/on-off, pace, opponent positional defense). Shadow-only while paused.
unsupported: all public prop picks paused until Brier & H2 beat DK no-vig

rules: Combines independent Moneyline, Spread, Totals, and Props specialist outputs for each game.
Blocks direct contradictions (e.g. Spread favorite cover + ML underdog on the same game).
Boosts consensus plays when Moneyline and Spread agree (+0.5% EV tie-break, higher confidence).
Checks Props consistency against projected team pace / Totals output.
Max 1 pick per game (highest coherent EV from supported specialists), -250 floor, DraftKings price.
